text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging incident (SEV2) — elevated 5xx rates across gateway -> envoy -> inference clusters in us-west-2. Auto-paging the on-call rotation. Root thread ts 1763456789

alex: i'm on it, seeing spike in 500/502 from gateway metrics (10x baseline). rolling window started ~1763456700.

maria: can someone grab envoy admin stats from the gateway LB? i want cluster health and outlier detection metrics.

jamal: running: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9901/clusters | head -n 40
```
# cluster: inference_pool_upstream
# lb_healthy_panic: 0
# hosts_removed_by_outlier_detection: 6
# hosts_added: 0
# membership_change: 6 removed
```

jamal: appears outlier detection ejected most hosts from the cluster (6/8). that's likely why requests are 5xx-falling through.

erin: any recent config changes to per-route retries / outlier detection? i can check the control plane (consul / envoy config repo).

lia: I see a recent config PR merged ~1763456600: "tweak envoy outlier detection & retry-allocation for inference" by infra/auto-deploy. PR changed consecutive_5xx to 5 -> 2 and base_ejection_time to 30s -> 10s.

alex: that would make ejections much more aggressive. if hosts are transiently failing due to load, they'd get ejected and cause 502s. need quick mitigation: revert the outlier change or widen thresholds + disable retries to reduce load on upstream.

maria: agree. short-term mitigation options:
- revert PR (control plane rollback) -> slower but clean
- adjust envoy admin to set max_ejection_percent lower? (not easily hotpatchable)
- disable per-route retries at gateway to reduce duplicate load

jamal: we can patch the gateway route retry policy to num_retries: 0, that is immediate and should reduce additional load generated by retries. i can push change to the control plane as a hotfix.

erin: also checking client-side timeouts — some clients had 10s timeout and are retrying quickly. we should coordinate to avoid cascading retries.

lia: i'm drafting a rollback PR now, but it'll take ~6-8 minutes to roll out across control plane. hotfix to set retries=0 should be faster.

alex: do the hotfix first. jamal, push it and post the command. i'll watch metrics and traces.

jamal: creating patch... applying to gateway route config for /v1/infer* -> set retry_policy.num_retries = 0
```
# kubectl apply -f gateway-retry-hotfix.yaml
# apiVersion: v1
# kind: ConfigMap
# data: gateway-route-retries: |
#   routes:
#     - path: /v1/infer
#       retry_policy:
#         num_retries: 0
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: gateway-config-hotfix (canary 10% -> 100%) started at 1763456902

jamal: canary up at 10% now. monitoring 5xx rate on canary vs baseline.

alex: dashboards show canary hosts 5xx dropped ~65% within 30s of canary. global 5xx dropping but still elevated. some ejections persisted.

lia: rollback PR merged to revert outlier detection change (back to consecutive_5xx = 5, base_ejection_time = 30s). hitting rollout now.

deploy-bot: rollback deploy started: control-plane-config (gradual rollout) at 1763456960

maria: also observed that circuit_breakers.max_connections was lowered in same PR from 1000 -> 200 for the inference cluster. that likely increased head-of-line failures when load spiked. we should revert that too.

jamal: adding that to rollback PR.

erin: quick customer impact note: 12 customers reported increased error rates (mostly Dedicated customers in us-west-2). some sustained 20-30% of requests failed for short windows. Sales/CS notified.

alex: updating incident timeline for postmortem: root cause: aggressive outlier detection + lowered circuit breaker limits + retries causing retry storms -> host ejections -> 502/503 cascade. Immediate mitigations: set retries to 0 (hotfix), rollback outlier & circuit breaker PR (control-plane rollback).

lia: rollback at 1763457001 completed in control plane, instances starting to recover. host ejection counts returning to normal.

jamal: verifying envoy admin now:
```
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9901/clusters | grep -A4 inference_pool_upstream
# hosts_removed_by_outlier_detection: 0
# lb_healthy_panic: 0
# membership_change: 0 added
```

alex: 5xx rate back to near normal ~1763457050. closing paging but keeping oncall watch for 30m.

erin: created incident ticket INC-2026-145 in PagerDuty with the timeline and customer impact matrix, assigned to infra and sres for follow-up.

maria: action items for postmortem:
- revert overly aggressive defaults in outlier detection and circuit breakers (done)
- add canary gating for outlier detection changes (smarter rollout)
- add synthetic traffic tests that simulate retry storms and validate host ejection behavior
- limits: define safe min for max_connections; prevent PRs that lower below safe threshold without perf data
- update runbook: if large ejections detected, immediately disable retries and evaluate CBs

lia: i'll own the rollout gating and synthetic test items. jamal/erin please own runbook update. alex to own postmortem writeup + customer comms draft.

jamal: thumbs up. i'm annotating traces and attaching sample trace IDs to the incident ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident SEV2 resolved -> monitoring window active for 30m. If any regression ping #incidents.

alex: thanks all. quick follow-ups after monitoring window: we need an RCA with timelines, PR ids, and the exact config diffs.

maria: noted — PR id 4821 is the offending change. adding to postmortem.

sre-rotations: great work on the rapid mitigation. looks like the hotfix + rollback sequence prevented larger customer impact. adding to oncall rotation notes. :white_check_mark:
